1.title: Carney asks Canada's provinces to end US alcohol ban as trade deal nears
1.summary: An agreement preventing a new wave of US tariffs is close and could include an end to Canada's boycott of US wine and spirits.

2.title: In a Big Year for Progressives, Here’s Why These Moderates Won Their Primaries
2.summary: At times this year, the Democratic Party’s centrist wing has felt under siege from the left. But it has won several tough primaries recently.

3.title: Massachusetts Police Search for Karen Solomon in Connection to Husband’s Death
3.summary: A Massachusetts woman who was known as an advocate for the mental health of emergency workers is being sought by the police after her husband, an officer, was found dead.

4.title: UK, France, Germany, Italy and Canada condemn Israel's West Bank settlement project
4.summary: European countries and Canada pile on pressure over Israel's plans to expand settlements in a strategically vital part of the occupied West Bank.

5.title: Bessent urges US partners to back plans to 'squash' Iran economy
5.summary: The US Treasury secretary says allies will need to decide whether they "are with us or against us".

6.title: First U.S. Deportees to Arrive in Liberia Amid Growing Backlash
6.summary: Critics in the small West African nation say their government has not said why it agreed to one of the largest U.S. deportation deals, who the deportees are, or how they will be handled.
